sentence: SSPDF has, however, been able to rely on the continued support of Ugandan forces, whose armed troops, tanks and armoured vehicles have remained in South Sudan since March 2025, in violation of the arms embargo established by Security Council resolution 2428 (2018) and renewed by resolution 2781 (2025).

The Panel considers the presence of armed UPDF forces in South Sudan to be a violation of the arms embargo as outlined in paragraph 4 of resolution 2428 (2018), eased by paragraph 2 of resolution 2683 (2023) and renewed by resolution 2781 (2025).
As these armed helicopters had not been observed in South Sudan prior to 2024, the Panel also considers their presence a likely violation of the arms embargo.
